item.title: Tecnologo: Monitoring, management and conservation of Mediterranean island habitats and invasive alien plant species in the Tuscan Archipelago (Univ. FIRENZE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 23:59
Institution: Univ. FIRENZE, Firenze

A public selection, based on qualifications and examinations, is announced for the recruitment of one second-level Technologist, pursuant to Article 24-bis of Law 240/2010, with a fixed-term contract lasting 24 months, at the Department of Biology of the University of Florence. The position will provide technical, scientific and management support to research activities carried out within the European project LIFE22-NAT-IT-LIFE TETIDE – “Turning Eradication Targets Into Durable Effects” and within the collaboration agreement with the Tuscan Archipelago National Park for vegetation monitoring on the islands of Capraia, Giannutri, Giglio and Montecristo CUP_B53C23004460006 e…
